source: Picked from Visit Detroit (visitdetroit.com) directory listings, The Infatuation's Detroit date-night list and OpenTable's Detroit date-night list; coordinates from those listing pages (Nov 2026)

spots.name: Campus Martius Park
spots.blurb: Downtown's central square with the skating rink and the city Christmas tree
spots.blurbEs: La plaza central del centro, con la pista de patinaje y el árbol de Navidad de la ciudad

spots.name: Detroit Institute of Arts
spots.blurb: Major art museum home to Diego Rivera's Detroit Industry murals
spots.blurbEs: Gran museo de arte con los murales Detroit Industry de Diego Rivera

spots.name: Charles H. Wright Museum of African American History
spots.blurb: Landmark museum of African American history and culture
spots.blurbEs: Museo emblemático de la historia y la cultura afroamericanas

spots.name: Eastern Market
spots.blurb: Historic public market, busiest on Saturdays from 6 am
spots.blurbEs: Mercado público histórico, con más ambiente los sábados desde las 6 am

spots.name: Detroit International RiverWalk
spots.blurb: Riverside walking path with skyline views, open daily 6 am to 10 pm
spots.blurbEs: Paseo junto al río con vistas al horizonte, abierto a diario de 6 am a 10 pm

spots.name: Detroit Zoo
spots.blurb: Big suburban zoo with timed tickets sold online, open 10 am to 4 pm in winter
spots.blurbEs: Gran zoológico en las afueras con entradas por horario en línea, abierto de 10 am a 4 pm en invierno
